CHANGES (list ALL modifications, one or multiple):

Change #1: [Category: Model Architecture]
- What: Add a jointly learned relative-position attention bias to every attention head in MaskedSASRec, using signed position differences clipped to [-63, 63] and initializing all bias values to zero; retain absolute positional embeddings and bidirectional attention. Apply the identical architecture through the predictor writer, loading one trained checkpoint per category.
- Why: Relative distances give the network an explicit way to distinguish recent interactions from distant ones across variable-length histories, including distances from the final query mask.

---

WHY current solution limited:
- Root cause: Attention currently represents order only through absolute positional embeddings, so learning that an interaction occurred a particular distance before a query requires inferring relationships between two positions.
- Evidence: The supplied architecture has no relative-distance attention term; validation HR@10 remains 0.45 for Electronics versus 0.61 for Movies_and_TV and CDs_and_Vinyl, although these results alone do not establish positional encoding as the cause.

HOW these changes address it:
- Mechanism: Add the learned per-head distance bias to attention logits before softmax, allowing each head to learn distance preferences while retaining content-dependent attention and padding exclusion.
- Expected improvement: Test the hypothesis that macro-average validation HR@10 increases from 0.565 to approximately 0.575–0.585; this is an experimental target, not an observed result.
- Synergy (if multiple changes): Not applicable; this is one architectural change, with all additional parameters trained jointly inside the existing network.

KEEP UNCHANGED (must explicitly list):
- Random seed: Preprocessing seed=0 and training seed=42.
- Data split: Identical supplied training and validation splits; no hidden test access or additional data.
- Model: One independent model per category, all four categories retained, existing dataset routing, and exactly one selected checkpoint loaded per category.
- Training: Existing masking and prefix sampling, sampled-softmax objective, 1,024 negatives, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, dropout, hidden dimension, blocks, heads, maximum length, patience, and category time limits.
- Epoch limit: Honor SASREC_EPOCHS, with the host default of 200.
- Evaluation: Unchanged pinned host evaluator with 200 validation users per category, 99 unique negatives, evaluation seed=42, and macro-average HR@10; retain identical local validation construction and checkpoint selection.
- Artifacts: DATA_DIR remains os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']; write checkpoints, metadata, and working/predict.py beneath the trial directory, retaining single-GPU execution.
